subject: Post-discovery: lock pilot deep-dive slot or we release
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock pilot deep-dive slot or we release

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- What we heard: Novapulse is evaluating a short pilot (3–4 weeks) to validate inference latency on your multi-tenant workload, prioritize cost per 1k tokens, and confirm model routing behavior for your international regions.
- Next step: Technical deep-dive + pilot planning with your infra lead and our solutions engineer (30 minutes).

We have two engineer-backed slots available next week and want to lock one for Novapulse if you can confirm within 48 hours:
1) Wed, May 5 — 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Thu, May 6 — 13:00–13:30 PT (engineer confirmed)

If neither works, tell us the best 30-minute windows you have and we’ll try to accommodate, but we will release the reserved slot if we don’t hear back by 48 hours.

Attached: pilot-plan-draft.pdf (draft scope + suggested success metrics). Also included a short agenda in the body of deep-dive so folks know what to prepare.

Agenda (30m)
- 5m: goals and success metrics (Novapulse)
- 10m: infra/latency profile and constraints (Novapulse + Redwood)
- 10m: deployment options and pilot mechanics (Redwood)
- 5m: next steps + action owners

Can you confirm which slot you prefer? If acceptable, please reply with the names/emails of the Novapulse attendees and we’ll send an invite.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: pilot-plan-draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Alex Li <alex.li@novapulse.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock pilot deep-dive slot or we release

Hi Connor —

Sorry I missed the call yesterday — got pulled into an exec review. Appreciate the concise recap.

We definitely want to move forward with a pilot, but calendar is tight next week. At the moment the two windows that work for our infra lead (Tess) and me are:
- Wed, May 5 — 09:00–09:30 PT (possible, but Tess is only tentative)
- Thu, May 6 — 13:00–13:30 PT (this is best for us)

If you can lock Thu at 13:00 PT and include our infra lead (tess.lang@novapulse.com) that would be ideal. If Thu doesn’t work for your engineer, we may need to push to the following week.

Also: can you attach the short list of items we should have ready on our side? I want to make sure Tess has the right metrics and logs available.

Thanks,
Alex Li
Senior Product Manager, Novapulse
alex.li@novapulse.com | +1 (617) 555-4221
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: internal — Novapulse availability (engineer check)

Connor —

Quick check: our SE (Nina) is only available Thu 13:00 PT for a hands-on session — Wed is a soft yes but Nina won’t be on. If we run without the SE it will be more of a product overview, which is OK for Alex but not ideal for pilot scoping.

Recommend we offer Thu 13:00 and make it an 8-hour lock window: ask Alex to confirm within 8 hours to reserve Nina, otherwise we release the engineer-backed slot and offer a general overview slot on Wed.

Ben, can you draft the short prep checklist (3 bullet items) and the one-slide ask for Nina to review?

-Marissa

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock pilot deep-dive slot or we release

Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply. We can lock Thu, May 6 — 13:00–13:30 PT with our SE (Nina) provided we get confirmation within 8 hours (Nina is being reallocated otherwise). Please confirm the attendee list (add Tess if you like) and we’ll send a calendar invite immediately.

Prep checklist (3 items) — please have this ready for the call:
1) a short sample request/response (JSON) representing your common inference workload or a small dataset (no PII).
2) baseline latency numbers and typical sequence lengths (p50/p95) for your top endpoints.
3) a short diagram or note on where inference will be called from (cloud region, VPC, or hybrid).

I’ve attached deep-dive-agenda.md and included a calendar link here: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/connor/slot-THU-130-130pt

If we don’t hear back by 17:12 PT today (8 hours), we’ll release the engineer-backed slot and offer Wed as a product overview only.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda.md
